Product:{\"sku\":\"7100133534\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Take a moment for yourself. Guided Meditations brings calming, voice-led meditation to your console — a peaceful space to relax, de-stress, and reconnect with a quieter mind, whether you have ten minutes or twenty.

No experience needed. Just pick a session, choose your setting, and let a warm, soothing voice guide you gently through every breath. Sink into tranquil visuals and softly flowing ambient sound, designed to ease away the noise of the day.

Whether you're winding down before sleep, settling a busy mind, or simply carving out a little calm in your routine, this is your invitation to slow down and just be.

Features

Soothing voice-guided meditations for all experience levels
Two calming guide voices to choose from
Shorter and longer sessions to fit your time
Beautiful, tranquil backgrounds you can select
Gentle ambient music to deepen your calm
A simple, peaceful experience — sit back, breathe, and unwind

Find your calm, one breath at a time.
